newsitem.title: USA: Corestates in buyback plan for odd lots.
newsitem.headline: Corestates in buyback plan for odd lots.

text.p: CoreStates Financial Corp said Thursday that it plans to offer a stock buy back program for its odd-lot shareholders. The program is being extended to owners of fewer than 100 shares as of April 9. The odd-lot tender offer, said the company, will be available to share owners April 21 through May 21, 1997.

The program is voluntary, said the bank, and participants will receive the average of the high and low price, as stated in the Wall Street Journal, for the day that acceptance forms are received, less a processing fee of 50 cents per share.

CoreStates said the program is being offered as a convenient and inexpensive opportunity for smaller shareholders to sell their stock. In addition, the bank said, the program is expected to generate administrative savings.
